primary_work.title: Intervening to Learn and Compose Causally Disentangled Representations

decision: NARROWED BEYOND IDENTIFIABLE INTERVENTION-CONTEXT CONCEPT MODELS — NOT ADOPTED
prior_art_boundary: attaching an intervention-aware context module to an arbitrary encoder-decoder is prior art
identifying representations of supplied concepts under single-concept interventions is covered by the paper theorem
composing supplied concept interventions for OOD generation does not identify the concept inventory or raw-language equivalence
gold concept or context indices, parser slots, target IDs, and intervention labels are supervision or leakage rather than discovered semantics
OOD composition, task success, and language-shuffle gaps cannot substitute for direct recovery of utterance and target partitions
counterexample: Two models related by simultaneous permutation or reparameterization of concept indices, intervention-context slices, concept-representation blocks, target blocks, raw-utterance classes, denotation, language encoder, reduced-form tensor, decoder, and policy preserve the complete observational and interventional law, context-module objective, single- and multi-concept generation quality, task metrics, and language-conditioned predictions while assigning different utterance equivalence relations and semantic target partitions.
official_code_status: paper-specific official code verified at an immutable commit; uv.lock, hash-pinned requirements, Snakemake workflow, and Zenodo dataset checksums are available; official test is GPU-only and reported to take about 90 minutes on an H100, while the full workflow requires a few hundred GPU hours
